Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last

three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 9. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 10. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 11. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 12. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 13. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 14. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 15. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 16. Failure to comply with any of the prescribed conditions may result in rejection of the bid.

1. Supply Period The successful bidder shall be required to supply the entire material within 30 (Thirty) days from the dat e of issuance of the Work Order/Purchase Order. 2. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) The bidder must submit the prescribed Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) along with the Technical Bid docume nts. Bids submitted without the required EMD shall be rejected at the technical evaluation stage. No exem ption from submission of EMD shall be allowed. 3. Completeness of Bid Conditional, incomplete or ambiguous bids shall not be considered and shall be liable for rejection during t echnical evaluation. 4. PAN and GST Registration The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of a valid PAN Card and GST Registration Certificate along with the Technical Bid. 5. Price Quotation The bidder shall quote the rates on an F.O.R. (Free on Road) basis, inclusive of all applicable charges, i ncluding loading, unloading, transportation and stocking at the designated delivery location. No additional charges shall be payable by the department beyond the quoted rates, except as expressly provided in the tender. 6. Income Tax Return The bidder shall submit a copy of the latest available Income Tax Return (ITR) filed for the preceding financ ial year along with the tender documents. 7. Escalation Matrix for Service Support The bidder/OEM shall submit a proper escalation matrix containing the names, designations and contact te lephone numbers of the concerned officials responsible for providing service support. 8. Dedicated/Toll-Free Service Support Number The bidder/OEM must have a dedicated telephone number or toll-free number for providing service suppor t. Documentary proof of the same shall be submitted along with the Technical Bid. 9. Minimum Annual Turnover The bidder must have a minimum annual turnover of ₹600.00 Lakh (Rupees Six Crore Only) during the immediately preceding financial year. 10. Turnover Certificate The bidder shall submit a duly certified turnover statement/certificate for the last three financial years, issu ed by a Chartered Accountant (CA), along with the Technical Bid. 11. Non-Blacklisting Affidavit The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on a ₹500/- Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, declaring that: a. The bidder has not been blacklisted, debarred or banned by any Government Department, Government Organisation, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) or Urban Local Body (ULB) during the last five years. b. The bidder or its proprietor/partners/directors, as applicable, has not been convicted by any competent court of law during the last five years. 12. Mandatory Certificates and Authorisation

The bidder/OEM must possess and submit valid copies of the following certificates/documents: a. ISO 9001:2015 – Quality Management System Certificate, issued by an accredited certification body. b. ISO 14001:2015 – Environmental Management System Certificate, issued by an accredited certification body. c. ISO 45001:2018 – Occupational Health and Safety Management System Certificate, issued by an accredi ted certification body. d. Authorised Converter Certificate issued by 3M, authorising the bidder/OEM for the relevant conversion a ctivities. All certificates must be valid as on the last date of submission of the tender. 13. Work Experience Criteria For fulfilling the work experience criteria, the bidder/OEM shall submit copies of Work Orders issued by any Central Government Department, State Government Department, Government Organisation, PSU or Urban Local Body for equipment fabrication work or supply of items of a similar nature. The submitted documents must establish the bidder's relevant experience in executing similar works. 14. Character Certificate The bidder shall submit a valid Character Certificate of the proprietor/owner/authorised head of the compa ny, issued by the competent authority, such as the District Magistrate (DM) or Superintendent of Police (SP ). A self-attested copy of the certificate must be enclosed with the Technical Bid. 15. Variation in Quantity The department reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity of materials as per its actual requir ements. The successful bidder shall be bound to supply the revised quantity at the approved rates and on the terms and conditions of the tender. 16. Right to Accept or Reject Tender The department reserves the absolute right to accept or reject any or all bids, either wholly or partially, at any stage of the tender process, and to cancel or withdraw the tender without assigning any reason whats oever. The decision of the competent authority shall be final, subject to applicable procurement rules and l aw. 17. Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Submission of the bid shall be deemed to constitute acceptance of all the terms and conditions mentioned in the tender document. Any deviation from the prescribed terms and conditions must be specifically disclo sed in the bid, failing which the bid may be rejected. . 17. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 18. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
